title: Sub-ball consequences of the Allard hypotheses (K-monotonicity, finite curvature integral, mass bound)
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers and p a real number with n < p. Let U be a subset of R^(n+l), V a RectifiableVarifold n l U with weight mu = V.weight, H : R^(n+l) -> R^(n+l), and delta, rho real numbers such that V.AllardHypotheses H p delta rho holds. Then for every z in R^(n+l) and every r with 0 < r <= rho and closed ball B_r(z) contained in B_rho(0): (a) B_r(z) is contained in U; (b) the lower integral of |H|^p over B_r(z) with respect to mu is finite; (c) K(z,r) := (r^(p-n) * integral^-_{B_r(z)} |H|^p dmu)^(1/p) <= delta (as an element of [0,infinity], i.e. V.scaledLpNorm H p z r <= ofReal delta); (d) mu(B_r(z)) <= (1 + delta) omega_n rho^n (as ofReal).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (p : ℝ), (n : ℝ) < p → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (δ ρ : ℝ), V.AllardHypotheses H p δ ρ → ∀ (z : Amb n ℓ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → r ≤ ρ → closedBall z r ⊆ closedBall 0 ρ → closedBall z r ⊆ U ∧ ∫⁻ x in closedBall z r, ‖H x‖ₑ ^ p ∂V.weight < ⊤ ∧ V.scaledLpNorm H p z r ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ ∧ V.weight (closedBall z r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + δ) * (unitBallVolume n * ρ ^ n))
